versions.content: For each TP.DT frame to be sent, the J1939Tp module shall previously call PduR_J1939TpCopyTxData with the following parameters: - the Identifier of the corresponding N-SDU, - PduInfoType structure with up to 7 bytes as SduLength, - the retry parameter, and - a pointer to a location where the upper layer stores its currently available data.
